svg.title: Four Core Seats, Two Expansion Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-core-six-person-scale; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Two Expansion Seats; subtitle: Base uses 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time and C means contractor. Numeric values show Base seat counts, so the last two seats are zero until expansion. Contractor headcount is not equivalent to full-time capacity.; caption: Canonical annual scenarios remain separate: Conservative $120,000 revenue at 32% produces $38,400 profit with four people; Base $535,000 at 45.0% produces $240,750 with four; Scaled $950,000 at 58% produces $551,000 with six.; stages: label: Principal and account owner; value: 1 FT in Base and Scaled; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own employer relationships, engagement scope, compensation disclosures, collections, and final commercial decisions. Maintain licenses required for personal activities and assign specialist work without delegating accountability.; label: Licensed benefits specialist; value: 1 C in Base and Scaled; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Run stop-loss and TPA market work, compare policy wording, document lasers and attachment points, and reconcile commission schedules. Escalate coverage mismatches before the employer commits to replacement terms.; label: PBM and claims analyst; value: 1 C in Base and Scaled; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain authorized claims extracts, NADAC matching, rebate reconciliation, and reproducible calculations using Python and SQL. Minimize identifiers and preserve source-to-output audit trails for each employer engagement.; label: Licensed workers' comp specialist; value: 1 C in Base and Scaled; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile payroll classes, experience-rating worksheets, loss runs, and carrier responses. Verify state-specific producer or adjuster authority and obtain written evidence for every proposed correction and contingent fee.; label: Expansion account manager; value: 0 Base seats; add 1 FT at Scaled; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add a full-time service owner for renewals, eligibility coordination, employer reporting, and collection follow-up. Licensed personnel retain regulated advice and placement responsibilities unless this seat also holds required authority.; label: Expansion clinical reviewer; value: 0 Base seats; add 1 C at Scaled; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add appropriately qualified clinical review capacity for authorized complex-claim analysis and stop-loss submission support. Limit access by role; carrier contracts and authorized decision-makers determine coverage and payment.
